name: New Horizon Aircraft Ltd.
summary:
New Horizon Aircraft (HOVR) reported a loss of $0.05 per share on revenue of $0.00 million for the fiscal first quarter ended August 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.08 per share. The company beat consensus estimates by 37.50%.

Horizon Aircraft is an advanced aerospace engineering company that is developing one of the world's first hybrid-electric VTOL (Vertical Take-Off and Landing) aircraft designed to fly most of its mission in traditional wing-borne flight, offering industry-leading speed, range, and operational utility.
subject: New Horizon Aircraft Beat Consensus Estimates

name: Delta Air Lines, Inc.
summary:
Delta Air Lines (DAL) reported earnings of $1.72 per share on revenue of $20.19 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.80 per share on revenue of $17.70 billion. The company missed consensus estimates by 4.44% while revenue grew 21.07% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fourth quarter earnings of $1.15 to $1.65 per share on revenue of approximately $19.2 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $1.81 per share on revenue of $17.3 billion for the quarter ending December 31, 2026.

Delta Air Lines Inc provides scheduled air transportation for passengers and cargo throughout the United States and around the world. The Company' business segments are airline and refinery.
subject: Delta Air Lines Missed Consensus Estimates, Guides Earnings Below Estimates, but Sees Revenue Above
